arguments.query: SELECT p.category, COUNT(*) n, MIN(r.refund_ts), MAX(r.refund_ts) FROM refunds r JOIN order_items oi ON oi.item_id=r.item_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id=oi.product_id WHERE r.refund_ts >= '2025-01-01' AND r.refund_ts < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC
